We design onboarding, core workflows and dashboards that get users to value fast and keep them paying. Book a call See our work What holds SaaS products back Users never reach the aha moment Trials stall before anyone sees value. Weak activation flows mean you pay to acquire users who churn before they understand what the product does for them. Power features bury the core As you ship more, the interface fills with settings, tabs and edge cases. The everyday workflow gets harder, and new users bounce off the complexity. Design cannot keep pace with the roadmap Engineering ships faster than design can support. Inconsistent patterns and one-off screens pile up into UX debt that slows every future release. How do global employment calculators help EOR and recruitment companies accelerate their sales cycles? EOR and recruitment companies often face long, complex sales processes because clients demand detailed, country-specific statutory cost breakdowns before signing contracts. The 1EOR Suite replaces manual calculations with highly visual, embeddable calculators. Your sales teams can generate precise employer cost quotes in under 30 seconds, reducing pricing friction, converting web traffic into hot leads, and accelerating client onboarding. What specific calculators and tools are included in the 1EOR Suite? Our product suite includes 8 specialized global HR and sales-enablement tools: Global Employer Cost Calculator : Computes statutory employer taxes, benefits, social insurance, and mandatory pension contributions for 175+ countries and territories. Global Salary Benchmark : Provides wage profiles (min, median, max) for 2,300+ job profiles across 175+ countries based on ILOSTAT and local databases. Compliance Risk Diagnostic : A 12-question audit assessing contractor misclassification risk across 175+ countries. Contractor True-Cost Calculator : Compiles misclassification liabilities, transfer fees, and payment rails into a single cost card. GCC vs EOR Decision Engine : Formulates the financial threshold for setting up a local corporate entity vs. employing via EOR. Global Mobility Cost Stack : Outlines visa relocation pathways, sponsorship costs, and processing times across 175+ countries. Regulatory Alerts Dashboard : Monitors World Bank, OECD, and local tax changes to protect EOR operators from rate drift. Cost to Employer + Employee : Full payroll ledger with employer cost, employee tax, social security, and net pay across 175+ countries. How do the calculators ensure compliance and statutory accuracy across 175+ countries? The 1EOR Suite utilizes an automated data-ingestion pipeline connected to institutional API nodes, including the OECD Tax Database, the World Bank Open Data library, and regional tax authorities. Our Regulatory Alerts Dashboard scans for changes in tax brackets, pension caps, and social security ceilings, keeping the calculators updated. Additionally, all calculators feature a robust offline baseline fallback to ensure calculations never fail during client presentations. Can we white-label the calculators to match our recruitment or HR brand? Yes. All components are built for complete white-labeling. EOR and staffing firms can customize corporate branding, fonts (supporting Google Fonts like Inter), CSS styling, and logos. These can be configured directly via secure iframe query parameters, integrated via our WordPress shortcode plugin, or fully customized under your own domain using our REST API endpoints. How does the security gateway protect our proprietary data and prevent API abuse? Traditional widgets expose database endpoints and licensing keys in client-side HTML, making them vulnerable to scraping. The 1EOR Suite routes all client queries through our server-side PHP Gateway proxy. The gateway applies domain locks (CORS verification) to block unauthorized hostnames, prevents automated scraping through rate limiting, and hides private database tokens. No personal worker data is ever processed, ensuring complete GDPR and UK-GDPR alignment. How do recruiters use the Contractor True-Cost and Compliance Risk tools to close clients? Recruiters use these tools during consultations to educate clients who are hesitant to hire full-time or are employing contractors illegally. By running the Compliance Risk Diagnostic and Contractor True-Cost calculators, recruiters can visually demonstrate the hidden expenses of contractor management and the massive financial liabilities of misclassification. Technology businesses are intangible, intellectual, problem-solution-driven companies .  You have to distinguish yourself with incredible content, remarkable branding, and strategic advertising campaigns that attract your ideal customer in their moments of pain . Not just any agency can step in and fit the bill here.  In the tech industry, you need marketers with technical backgrounds that understand buyer pain points and have the creativity to market these complex products and services. At Tortoise and Hare Software, that's all we do. You know that won't scale much further and you want to start building a more sustainable system. You will succeed with or without our help, and are fully committed to growth.  You are already investing in marketing and are looking for a partner that can help you accelerate things. It takes a certain skill set to manage such complexity and a real love for problem solving.  This skillset rarely overlaps with the creative and communication skills needed to sustainably market a technology business, and many founders struggle to make it past the point of business generated from their immediate network of contacts.  Scaling up takes more than that. Big gains come with big effort and big effort takes a persistent long term dedication and focus.  Aesop's fable taught us that it takes humility and perseverance to win the big races, and that's where we come in. Tortoise and Hare Software is a digital marketing agency founded on principles learned from the fable of The Tortoise and The Hare.  We know it's slow and steady that wins the race and we bring a mentality of getting one percent better every day to our clients. We work primarily with B2B technology firms such as managed IT service providers (MSPs), Cybersecurity firms, and SaaS companies to craft and execute on digital marketing strategies that drive their business forward. Meet The Team Meet the team that helps us bring our products and services to market. Hunter Nelson President, Founder Hunter has been building web applications and marketing online for over 12 years. Kyla Rehberg Cofounder Kyla coordinates field marketing efforts, and weighs in on brand strategy and creative. Staffing Agency Support Copywriter Contractor Our copywriters develop brand voice and create content for web, ads, and more. Designer Contractor Our designers produce visual assets and shape brand expression across channels. Web Developer Contractor Our web developers help us build websites, upload content, and optimize for search and AI. Our Brand Characters You may not get to meet them in person, but we have a few brand characters that you may want to get acquainted with. Meet Dash Meet MegaByte Meet Aesop Meet Dash Meet MegaByte Meet Aesop Dash The Hare The first thing that will jump out at you in our digital solutions are the clean crisp look and lightning speed. Life’s too short to look at a loading screen on your mobile phone. But the speed doesn’t end there. We know that many business owners today don’t want a technology product, they want a technology partner. That’s why we focus on prompt customer support and take a proactive approach to communication and understand your business to make recommendations that help you achieve your goals. We also realize that great digital strategies starts with communication and education. We do our best to present an air of professionalism and service from your first call to your initial quote. Just another way we get out to a fast start. Dash Represents: Speed Agility Boldness & Creativity Confidence & Decisive Action Proactive Communication Quick Wins Sleek Applications With Speedy Load Times Megabyte The Tortoise Aesop’s classic fable taught us that confidence and speed can make a great first impression, but it’s the slow and steady that wins in the long run. Our goal is to provide you with a luxury service experience and a long term relationship you can be proud of. That’s why our digital services incorporate the values of the tortoise. We take the time to consider design from your perspective and your customer’s perspective to make our work products more user friendly, easy to navigate, and visually appealing. Tortoise and Hare Software knows that great outputs starts with taking the time to listen, understand pain points, discover needs, and deliver a solution that eliminates stress and gives you the tools to grow. MegaByte Represents: Long Term Focus A Commitment to Quality Humility Perseverance Stable Returns Victory! Aesop The Wise Meet Aesop. Aesop has been there before and is as wise as they come.  He helps companies navigate the digital economy with with digital strategies, effective research, and insights that you just can't find anywhere else. Aesop guides Dash and MegaByte along to form one cohesive team to help deliver superior market value. Aesop Represents: Wisdom Insights Guidance Strategic Thinking Documentation Organization Librarian Stewardship Corporate Brand Information Mission Statement We help technical founders move up-market and build the long term success they deserve. Core Values Prosperity Prosperity is one of our core values here at Tortoise and Hare. We believe that every American can achieve the state of health, wealth, and happiness that they desire through the development of internal accountability, a dedication to self improvement, and sharing of their success to improve the lives of others in their sphere of influence. Knowledge One of the foundations of prosperity is a commitment to lifelong learning and the quest for knowledge. Knowledge leads to wisdom, a sense of peace, and confidence that can’t be obtained through other means. Knowledge is also one of the key pillars of delivering excellence in business, but it enriches lives on a personal level as well. Apprenticeship Humanity has an amazing and unique ability to pass down knowledge obtained from many lifetimes of experience that came before us. The amount of study handed down from the generations before us in your average prescription pill that enriches so many of our lives is often taken for granted. We want to continue the tradition of enriching the lives of those that come after us through the process of apprenticeship. In many ways we all have a duty to learn from the sacrifices and wisdom of our ancestors by studying previous and current masters of a craft. Craftsmanship Digital marketing and software development aren't all that different from carpentry or other physical incarnation of craftsmanship. Although it’s harder to understand and appreciate from an outsiders perspective than a beautiful house, true craftsmen (and craftswomen!) derive a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment from a job well done rather than external validation. We here at Tortoise and Hare take pride in our work and derive satisfaction from delivering outstanding end results. Causes We Support We spend our day to day lives helping people while running the business of Tortoise and Hare Software, so we balance out our people contributions with environmental conversation efforts and the combating of climate change through our philanthropy.  We love to support our cousins in the sea with our annual Sea Turtle nest adoption campaign. About Us
# We started Hilario because great products deserve better marketing.

Our Story
Hilario was built for B2B SaaS companies that have outgrown their current marketing but are not ready for a full in-house team. We have worked with founders, sales leaders, and operators across Canada and the United States, helping them build the positioning, content, and sales materials that close more deals.

The Team

Partner and Marketing Strategist

Hamed has spent over a decade working with tech founders and operators across North America and internationally. He co-founded TechRasa, a leading startup media and market research company, where he interviewed dozens of founders, worked closely with their teams, and built a deep understanding of how fast-growing companies tell their story, find their market, and scale.

That experience—sitting inside many companies and understanding their buyers, their positioning, and their gaps—is the foundation of how Hilario works.

Hamed’s work has been featured in Forbes, Bloomberg, HuffPost, PBS, and PRI.

Zeynab has led design for tech companies across North America, building visual identities and creative systems that work across digital and print. She brings structure and consistency to every engagement, from brand assets to sales collateral to web design.

Because Zeynab works alongside the marketing strategy from day one, what your buyers see is always consistent. The website, the deck, and the LinkedIn post all tell the same story.

About Us
# We started Hilario because great products deserve better marketing.

Our Story
Hilario was built for B2B SaaS companies that have outgrown their current marketing but are not ready for a full in-house team. We have worked with founders, sales leaders, and operators across Canada and the United States, helping them build the positioning, content, and sales materials that close more deals.

The Team

![Image 1: Hamed Jafari](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/hamed-jafari-headshot-_57igni4.avif)

Hamed Jafari

Partner and Marketing Strategist

Hamed has spent over a decade working with tech founders and operators across North America and internationally. He co-founded TechRasa, a leading startup media and market research company, where he interviewed dozens of founders, worked closely with their teams, and built a deep understanding of how fast-growing companies tell their story, find their market, and scale.

That experience—sitting inside many companies and understanding their buyers, their positioning, and their gaps—is the foundation of how Hilario works.

Hamed’s work has been featured in Forbes, Bloomberg, HuffPost, PBS, and PRI.

* * *

![Image 2: Zeynab Abdolghaffari](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/zeynab-abdolghaffari-headshot-BhlXskD1.avif)

Zeynab Abdolghaffari

Partner and Creative Director

Zeynab has led design for tech companies across North America, building visual identities and creative systems that work across digital and print. She brings structure and consistency to every engagement, from brand assets to sales collateral to web design.

Because Zeynab works alongside the marketing strategy from day one, what your buyers see is always consistent. The website, the deck, and the LinkedIn post all tell the same story.

As Seen In

![Image 3: Forbes](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/forbes-WUfbrSFr.png)![Image 4: Bloomberg](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/bloomberg-DAfAzSop.png)![Image 5: HuffPost](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/huffpost-B9wOjJim.png)![Image 6: PBS](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/pbs-CV0XJ2c5.png)![Image 7: PRI](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/pri-DWGn_sSR.png)

![Image 8: Forbes](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/forbes-WUfbrSFr.png)![Image 9: Bloomberg](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/bloomberg-DAfAzSop.png)![Image 10: HuffPost](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/huffpost-B9wOjJim.png)![Image 11: PBS](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/pbs-CV0XJ2c5.png)![Image 12: PRI](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/pri-DWGn_sSR.png)

Our Network
Depending on the scope of an engagement, we bring in specialists from our network across North America. People we have worked with, trust, and have delivered results with before. You get the depth of a full team with the consistency of working directly with the people who lead the work.

pages.cleaned_text: The Dev Environment & Team Your Product Needs | Boldare Hello. We are Boldare - digital product creators & consultants We exist to help our clients redefine their industries by building with them the products their users want How do we win? We’ve created a pioneering dev environment that jet-fuels the way we deliver our second-to-none services and products. Let us show you how it works! Created in 2004, we have grown into a team of 200+ team with 6 offices across Europe. From the start, we wanted to disrupt product development services, be light years ahead of our competition so we needed to do things differently Inspired by those who challenged the status quo Unlike others, we've invested as much in a future-proof dev environment as we have in building our business & services With a combined focus on both we are able to win big, and drive six-figure results for our clients. The environment is where everything starts 1 Processes and structure Product life cycle stages are miles apart! Careers Press Login Schedule a Demo MikMak Helps Brands Grow, Real-Time MikMak is a global software company that provides the leading commerce intelligence and orchestration platform for brands. We give them the real-time edge to optimize conversion, shift media spend instantly, and turn predictive insights into decisive business growth. Schedule a Demo We Are Brand Obsessed The brands of tomorrow will be built on real-time commerce intelligence. Success requires the ability to enable, measure, optimize, and plan— leveraging complex media, retail, and first-party insights to inspire consumer action faster than ever before. What will separate the winners is the ability to use this intelligence to drive decisions throughout a brand's entire lifecycle and across its partner ecosystem. That is why our mission at MikMak is to turn this intelligence into action, becoming the #1 converter of global consumers. Trusted by the World's Best Brands About MikMak MikMak is the leading global platform for commerce intelligence and orchestration. Our software grows brands in real-time by enabling commerce in the places where their shoppers spend time, measuring the omnichannel outcome of those interactions, and helping them to plan and optimize future outcomes. In 2023, MikMak significantly expanded its global footprint across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM through the acquisition of French eCommerce enablement company Swaven. That same year, the company further deepened its commerce insights by acquiring ChannelAdvisor’s Shoppable Media and Brand Analytics product lines from Rithum (formerly CommerceHub). In January of 2026, MikMak was acquired by SPINS, bringing together two category leaders in commerce intelligence and best-in-class data and insights. The combined entity provides brands with an unrivaled, unified view of availability, point-of-sale performance, and consumer behavior, globally and in real time. Interested in becoming part of the MikMak team? Check out our Careers page to learn more. Join MikMak Our Company Values Be Brand Obsessed Know, love, and support our customers’ and partners’ businesses so we can build the future with them. Be an Innovator Our industry moves at lightspeed, so our ideas and actions must move even faster. Unite MikMak We win as a team. We help each other succeed, push each other to improve, and celebrate progress together. Put the MikMoose on the table Open, honest communication drives success. Silence kills businesses. Awards Did You Know, We’re Patented? MikMak’s invention, U.S. Patent No. 11,475,487, outlines the key technologies used to power multi-retailer selection and checkout within online video marketing campaigns. #### REVENUE

## E-Commerce

Give guests an easy way to discover and buy tickets, experiences, F&B, merchandise or upgrades from their phone,  
 whether they’re planning ahead or deciding what they want next while already inside the venue.

[Book a Demo](http://vantage.co/request-a-demo/ "Request A Demo")

### MORE WAYS TO SPEND

## Create More Opportunities to Add to the Day

**For guests:** Easily discover, purchase and add to their experience without having to visit a service desk.

**For operators:** Capture more revenue, promote add-ons and make it easier for guests to spend without adding more work for frontline teams.

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IEVTe0JE6dg)

![Image 4](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/4-1.png)

### Connected Commerce

## Keep the Opportunity to Purchase Open

Respond to Demand in Real Time

Keep what guests see aligned with what’s actually available. Update inventory, availability and offerings as demand changes throughout the day, helping your team promote what you have capacity for and capture more revenue from available experiences and products.

Make Your Offers More Relevant

Use what you know about each guest to surface more relevant products, upgrades and experiences. Personalized recommendations create natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell while helping guests discover additions that make sense for their visit.

Increase Convenience to Increase Spend

Give guests an easy way to browse and purchase tickets, upgrades, experiences, F&B and merchandise directly from their phone. They can add to their day whenever the opportunity arises, without finding a service desk, joining another line or interrupting what they’re already doing.

### How It Works

## Sell Beyond the Initial Booking

### Guests Browse

Guests explore upgrades, F&B, and other add-ons directly from their phones, reducing reliance on frontline teams to manage upgrades and additional purchases.

### Up-to-Date Inventory

What guests see can reflect availability, inventory and where they are in their visit, keeping purchase options relevant to the moment.

### Personalize the Experience

Surface relevant products and add-ons based on guest information and activity, creating more natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell.

### Guest Purchases

Guests can buy or upgrade directly from their device without visiting a service desk or interrupting their day.

### One Guest Profile

Transactions become part of the connected guest profile, giving operators a clearer picture of how each guest spends and engages.

### Adjust Store

Use purchasing and guest behaviour to understand what’s working, adjust offerings and create more relevant opportunities throughout the rest of the visit.

About DistyMan E-Commerce, Graphic Design & Marketing for Electronic Component Companies Since 2005, DistyMan has helped electronic and electrical component manufacturers and distributors improve how they present, manage, market and sell technical products. We combine e-commerce technology, graphic design, technical content and digital marketing in one industry-focused team. Electronic & Electrical Component E-Commerce Website & Responsive Design Catalog, Datasheet & Graphic Design Technical Content & Product Data SEO, AEO & GEO Optimization Digital Marketing & Advertising Book a Demo Contact Us WHO WE ARE Built Around the Electronic & Electrical Component Industry DistyMan is a design, development and marketing company focused on the
      electronic and electrical component industry. We work with manufacturers,
      distributors and related technical organizations that need to manage complex
      product information, communicate technical value and reach engineers, buyers
      and purchasing teams online. Our capabilities span e-commerce, graphic design, technical content,
      product data, SEO and digital marketing , allowing clients to work
      with one team across the complete digital and print marketing process. OUR HISTORY From Creative Agency to Complete Digital Commerce Partner DistyMan began in 2005 as a marketing and creative agency supporting technical
      companies with websites, product catalogs, advertising, specification libraries
      and other sales and marketing materials. As manufacturers and distributors moved more of their product information and
      sales processes online, our work expanded into product databases, custom web
      development, B2B e-commerce , technical search and system integration. That experience led to the development of DistyMan's proprietary e-commerce
      technology while preserving the graphic design, technical content and marketing
      capabilities that were part of the company from the beginning. Today, DistyMan can support an electronic or electrical component company from
      initial brand and website design through product data, e-commerce, technical
      content, SEO and ongoing digital marketing. WHAT WE DO Three Disciplines Working as One Electronic component companies often need design, technology and marketing
        services at the same time. DistyMan combines all three instead of treating
        them as separate projects. E-Commerce Design, develop and manage e-commerce websites built around large technical
          catalogs, manufacturers, part numbers, specifications and complex B2B requirements. B2B e-commerce B2C / retail e-commerce Unified commerce Marketplace development ERP and API integrations Graphic Design Create professional visual communications that make technical products
          easier to understand, compare, select and promote. Website design Catalogs & selection guides Datasheet design Technical infographics Advertising & brand materials Marketing Increase product visibility and reach engineers, buyers, distributors
          and customers through coordinated digital marketing. SEO, AEO & GEO Google Ads & remarketing Press release marketing Email & social campaigns Technical article development E-COMMERCE E-Commerce Designed for Technical Product Catalogs Electronic and electrical component e-commerce is different from conventional
      retail. Customers may search by exact manufacturer part number, specification,
      package, voltage, current, frequency, product family or application. DistyMan designs and develops e-commerce systems around these requirements,
      including large catalogs, parametric search, customer-specific pricing, RFQs,
      inventory feeds, ERP integration and technical documentation. Product Data Organize manufacturers, part numbers, categories, attributes, images and technical documents. Product Search Support keyword, part-number, parametric, cross-reference and technical product discovery. B2B Commerce Support customer pricing, RFQs, purchase orders, approvals and account-specific workflows. Integrations Connect ERP, CRM, PIM, inventory, supplier, distributor and marketplace systems. GRAPHIC DESIGN Design That Makes Complex Products Easier to Understand Technical products require more than attractive graphics. Designers must
      understand specifications, product families, applications and how engineers
      evaluate competing components. DistyMan combines technical industry knowledge with professional graphic
      design to create visual materials that support product selection, sales and
      brand consistency across digital and print channels. Web Design Responsive websites and product interfaces designed for technical catalogs and e-commerce. Catalogs & Guides Print and digital catalogs that organize products, specifications and selection information. Datasheets Professional layouts for specifications, drawings, features and application information. Marketing Creative Advertising, infographics, email graphics, presentations and product-launch materials. CONTENT + PRODUCT DATA Turn Engineering Information Into Useful Sales Content Product specifications alone do not always explain why a component is useful,
      how it differs from alternatives or where it should be applied. DistyMan can
      transform source materials into organized technical content for websites,
      e-commerce, catalogs and marketing. Specifications Organize attributes, values and units into consistent product data structures. Technical Writing Develop product descriptions, features, benefits, applications and educational content. Documentation Create and manage datasheets, technical resources, catalogs and selection guides. Visual Content Convert technical information into diagrams, infographics and application graphics. DIGITAL MARKETING Marketing Built Around Technical Products and Qualified Buyers DistyMan helps component companies promote products throughout the research
      and purchasing process. Campaigns can connect technical content, search
      visibility, advertising and product pages rather than treating each channel
      as an isolated marketing activity. SEO Optimize categories, manufacturers, part numbers and technical content for organic search. AI Search Support AEO, GEO, structured data and machine-readable content for emerging discovery channels. Paid Advertising Reach customers through Google Ads, product campaigns and remarketing. Content Marketing Support launches and ongoing visibility with articles, email, press releases and social content. ONE CONNECTED STRATEGY From Product Data to Product Discovery A strong electronic component website depends on more than one discipline.
      Product data affects search. Search affects website navigation. Technical
      content affects SEO. Graphic design affects usability. Advertising works
      better when landing pages and product pages support the campaign. DistyMan connects these activities so each part of the project supports the
      others. Data Organize manufacturers, categories, specifications, documents and part numbers. Design Turn complex technical information into intuitive interfaces and professional marketing materials. Commerce Connect product information to RFQs, accounts, inventory, pricing and purchasing. Marketing Increase visibility through search, advertising, technical content and ongoing campaigns. TECHNOLOGY WITHOUT LIMITING YOUR OPTIONS Our Platform or the Technology That Fits Your Business DistyMan has developed proprietary e-commerce technology for technical and
      data-intensive applications, but our services are not limited to a single
      platform. We can design, develop and market websites using DistyMan technology or
      established third-party platforms when they are the better fit. The objective
      is to select technology around the products, customers and business requirements
      rather than forcing the business to conform to the platform. INDUSTRY FOCUS Why Electronic & Electrical Components Require Specialized Experience Component companies operate with technical requirements that conventional
      web agencies may rarely encounter. Large catalogs, parametric specifications,
      manufacturer part numbers, datasheets, customer pricing, inventory feeds and
      engineering terminology are fundamental parts of the customer experience. Technical Catalogs Manage hundreds of thousands or millions of products and technical attributes. Engineering Buyers Design search, content and navigation around how engineers evaluate products. B2B Requirements Support pricing levels, RFQs, credit terms, accounts and purchasing workflows. Connected Systems Integrate web commerce with ERP, inventory, PIM, CRM and supplier data. DISTYMAN TODAY Design, Technology, Content and Marketing Under One Roof The combination of creative, technical and marketing capabilities that shaped
      DistyMan from the beginning remains central to how we work today. Industry Focus Services centered on electronic and electrical component manufacturers and distributors. End-to-End Capability Design, development, product data, technical content, e-commerce and marketing from one team. Global Support Distributed support resources serving customers across multiple regions and time zones. Ongoing Partnership Continue improving websites, content, applications and marketing after launch. WHY DISTYMAN? A Different Kind of Partner for Component Companies Industry Knowledge We understand component terminology, technical product data and the audiences manufacturers and distributors need to reach. Creative + Technical Graphic design and marketing are supported by development, data and technical content expertise. Commerce + Marketing Product discovery, e-commerce and digital marketing can operate as one connected strategy. Long-Term Support We can continue managing, improving and marketing the platform as requirements change. E-COMMERCE + DESIGN + MARKETING One Team for Your Complete Digital Product Strategy DistyMan helps electronic and electrical component companies design better
      product experiences, build stronger e-commerce systems and generate more
      visibility through technical content and digital marketing. Whether you need a new website, e-commerce platform, catalog, technical content
      program or ongoing marketing support, we can build the right combination of
      services around your business. Talk With DistyMan FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS About DistyMan What does DistyMan specialize in? DistyMan specializes in e-commerce, graphic design, technical content and
        digital marketing for electronic and electrical component manufacturers
        and distributors. Does DistyMan only provide e-commerce software? No. DistyMan also provides website and graphic design, custom development ,
        product data management, technical writing, SEO and digital marketing. Can you work with an existing e-commerce platform? Yes. DistyMan can support proprietary and third-party e-commerce environments
        depending on the client's existing technology and requirements. Can DistyMan manage technical product content? Yes. Services can include specifications, attributes, product descriptions,
        datasheets, catalogs, selection guides, technical writing and infographics. Do you provide marketing after the website launches? Yes. Ongoing services can include SEO, AEO, GEO, Google Ads, remarketing, email marketing , press releases, articles and social media content. Why use an industry-focused company? Electronic and electrical component websites frequently involve large catalogs,
        technical specifications, manufacturer part numbers, parametric search and
        specialized B2B purchasing requirements. DistyMan's services are designed
        around those needs. Service on demand A Team Behind Every Project Available on demand or under contract — decades of experience across web, print, content and AI. We specialize in websites for manufacturers and distributors. Maintenance 24/5 support across the United States, India and Malaysia. Continuous monitoring and process improvement across all deployments. Ongoing development Continual improvement under an ISO 9001:2015 process. Custom ERP, payments and workflow requirements are encouraged. Design Award-winning design from concept through wireframes and production — tuned for industrial catalogs and conversion. Content & ads Product data, datasheets, SEO copy, PPC and campaigns so the site keeps working after launch. Book a Demo Contact Us Digital commerce, product data and growth services for electronic and electrical component manufacturers and distributors. ServiceOcean ist Experte für Kundenservice und Anruferverhalten in der Warteschleife. Ob in der klassischen IVR oder mit KI-Agenten: datengetriebene Optimierungen, Behavioral Science und optimale Dialoge sind der Schlüssel zum Erfolg und bringen Unternehmen auf den Weg zu 100 % Erreichbarkeit.

- [x] ![Image 79: Icon Zielscheibe mit Pfeil](https://www.serviceocean.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/goal.svg)Customer Journey aus einer Hand 

ServiceOcean begleitet Kunden durch die gesamte Customer Journey. Vom Anruf im Servicecenter über Anliegenerkennung und Routing, die Bearbeitung einfacher Anliegen mit KI-Agenten bis hin zur Planung eines Termin-Rückrufs mit menschlichen Mitarbeitenden.

- [x] ![Image 80: Icon Robot](https://www.serviceocean.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/013-150x150.png)SO Agent: Anliegenerkennung, Routing und FAQ 

Ob Anliegenerkennung, Conversational Routing, oder die LLM-basierte Beantwortung von einfachen Fragen – SO Agent übernimmt die Basics im telefonischen Kundenservice verlässlich. Kann ein Anliegen nicht gelöst werden oder möchten Kunden lieber mit einem Agenten sprechen, wird nahtlos zu einem Menschen verbunden.

- [x] ![Image 81: icon blau nutzer mit uhr](https://www.serviceocean.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/ic-users-time.svg)SO Callback: Menschen verbinden 

Es besteht Gesprächsbedarf mit einem menschlichen Mitarbeitenden? SO Callback bietet sofort einen verbindlichen Exit aus dem Gespräch mit dem KI-Agenten. Die Lösung für eine nahtlose Customer Journey: Ein Callback-Angebot, statt Kunden einfach in die Warteschleife zu schicken und dort verharren zu lassen. Ist die Warteschleife länger als 60 Sekunden, wird ein kapazitätsbasierter Termin-Rückruf, virtuelles oder freiwilliges Warten angeboten.

## **Since 2013, ServiceOcean has represented 100% of calls handled for inbound service centers**

****SO Callback leverages behavioral science and optimized IVR scripts to offer smart alternatives before callers abandon their calls and redial.** Callers can choose between scheduled callbacks, virtual queuing, or waiting in a traditional queue. In this way, the software (SaaS) reduces call handling costs by up to 85%—while simultaneously improving KPIs and significantly increasing both customer and employee satisfaction.**

### **From a volcanic eruption to a start-up**

In 2010, the Eyjafjallajökull volcano erupted in Iceland in the midst of Dr. Alexander Schagen’s multi-year project conducting real-world research into success factors in service and sales at the[University of St.Gallen (HSG)](https://www.unisg.ch/en/).When it erupted, Eyjafjallajökull flung enormous amounts of volcanic ash into the atmosphere, creating a cloud that severely disrupted air travel.Countless flights were grounded, resulting in an immense call volume and long wait times at the airlines’ service centers.

At this time, Dr. Schagen was writing his dissertation on the success factors for inbound service centres at the[Institute for Marketing and Customer Insight of the University of St.Gallen (HSG)](https://imc.unisg.ch/),and was also working on a long-term consulting project for Swiss International Air Lines. Queues were quickly identified as the biggest problem for customer service.

**Today, ServiceOcean is an award-winning market and innovation leader for calls handled – with zero wait time.**

![Image 71: Vulkan Eyjafjallajökull](https://www.serviceocean.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/serviceocean_adobestock_27210762-800x533-1.webp)

**What does Eyjafjallajökull have to do with ServiceOcean?**

And thus, the idea behind ServiceOcean was born at the University of St.Gallen in 2013.

**“Wherever there are waiting times, scheduling is the solution. In this way, we have been able to improve the world of service. We can now design queues in an efficient manner and offer excellent customer service. Our vision: We turn “service deserts” into oceans.”**

**Thomas Addison,**  
Founder and CEO

**Once we had all of the findings from the research project, we came up with the idea of developing an innovative call center software, and we were able to establish our own company. What drives us? Revolutionizing call handling.**

**Dr. Alexander Schagen,**  
Founder of Service Ocean

![Image 72](https://www.serviceocean.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ueber-uns-1024x834.png)

**THOMAS ADDISON AND ALEXANDER SCHAGEN**

### ****The founders of Service Ocean****

Before founding ServiceOcean, Thomas Addison worked for a wide range of companies in Switzerland as an SAP consultant. He studied Business Informatics at the University of Mannheim. Dr. Alexander Schagen researched and lectured at the University of St.Gallen (HSG) on the topic of success factors in call centers. With this combination of a research background and real-world expertise, the two founders began revolutionizing call handling.

******AND THE STORY CONTINUES...******

### Our Story

Soldo was founded in London in 2015 by entrepreneurs and banking experts who saw the need for a better way to manage business spending.

Our name comes from the Italian word for a coin once used for small everyday transactions. It reflects our focus on the purchases that keep companies running but are difficult to track and control.

We welcomed our first customer in 2017. Today we serve more than 25,000 organisations across 31 countries, helping companies in industries from manufacturing and media to healthcare and retail.

What started as a solution to improve visibility over small purchases has grown into a platform that transforms how businesses approach spending. Our story is still being written as we continue to grow and innovate.

### What is Soldo?

Our vision is to put a company card in the hand of every employee so that businesses can move faster without losing control of spending.

We do this by combining company cards with intuitive software to make managing business spend simple.

Finance teams gain real time visibility and control. Employees get the autonomy to make purchases that help them do their best work.

Businesses use Soldo to manage travel and expenses, set team budgets, and handle unpredictable spending.

### Our Philosophy: Progressive Finance

Traditional finance processes are often slow, messy, and restrictive. They hold back employees and leave finance teams tied up in admin.

Progressive Finance is our vision for a better way. It is built on trust, autonomy, agility, transparency, innovation, and empowerment.

We believe in giving employees controlled freedom while providing finance leaders with the oversight they need. The result is a workplace where people feel trusted, and finance has the clarity to support growth.

## HUMANS BEHIND THE SCENE

# About us

CaptainBook.io was founded in 2021 by Jerome Bajou, a travel industry expert and serial entrepreneur & Luca Lattanzio, a travel industry leader and technical sales guru. Our goal is to help tour and activity operators making the most of their business by reducing the amount of commission they give away while making their life easier.

[![Image 2: Luca Lattanzio](https://framerusercontent.com/images/3mA7I9sBtZhF7mDqNuWqGPyihM.jpg?width=500&height=500) Book a demo with Luca](https://www.captainbook.io/about-us)

![Image 4](https://framerusercontent.com/images/NLgjNWkEj5hp7gMcZQSFSazVKwI.png?width=800&height=600)

# How it all started

Back in 2012, co-founder Jerome was working as a tour operator in a sailing tour company in Naxos Island (Greece). His passion for sailing made him believe that he would be able to sail every day, spending all his time on his boat. The reality was different. He found himself stuck on his phone for most of the day, sending emails, taking bookings manually, managing paperwork and taking care of its prospects.

Luca was selling experiences, including Jerome's sailing tours, while managing properties and accommodations in Naxos. The whole process of reselling tours was very complicated, time consuming, and very stressful.

Both frustrated, they decided to act, changing things for themselves in 2016, where Jerome wrote a small cloud based app known later as being the base of CaptainBook.io. They then decided to open the project to all tour operators of the world, helping tons of experience-based businesses managing their operations, and reselling networks.

# The team

We are working hard to create the tools of tomorrow, improving your business, your rentability and helping you setting higher goals.

Vicious Marketing works with businesses in regulated markets that need more customers but can't pinpoint what is holding them back. Leads have dried up, acquisition costs keep climbing, revenue has gone flat, and every agency has a different answer. We diagnose where your business model is actually breaking, then fix that specific problem, inside the rules your regulator sets. Book Your Free Acquisition Teardown Who we are Not another agency selling a channel. The team that finds the real problem. Most businesses come to us with a symptom, not a cause. Sales have slowed, cost per customer is rising, or marketing spend keeps growing while revenue doesn't. They know something is wrong. They don't know where. That is the gap we fill. We don't start by selling SEO, ads or a new website. We start by finding where your growth model is leaking, whether that is the offer, the funnel, the channel mix, the tracking or a compliance constraint, and then fix the part that is actually broken. We specialise in regulated markets, where those problems are hardest to see and most expensive to get wrong. iGaming Finance (CFD/Forex) Fintech B2B SaaS Cybersecurity Who we help Does this sound like your business? If any of these are true, the problem usually isn't effort or budget. It's a leak nobody has found yet. 01 Growth has stalled and nobody inside the business can explain why. 02 Your cost to win a customer keeps rising every quarter. 03 Your agency reports good numbers, but revenue isn't moving. 04 You can't tell which channel is actually bringing in paying customers. 05 Regulations block the tactics that work for everyone else. 06 You've tried more spend, a new agency or a new website, and the problem came back. Our story Built to end the guesswork in acquisition Vicious Marketing started with a problem our founder, Eyal Dror, kept seeing: companies in regulated markets were spending heavily on marketing with no clear view of which part was actually working. Growth would stall, cost per customer would creep up every quarter, and the agencies they hired answered with more activity: more content, more campaigns, more dashboards full of clicks. Spend rose, acquisition cost rose with it, and nobody could point to the lever that moved revenue. We built Vicious Marketing to replace that guesswork with diagnosis: find where the business is really breaking, fix that specific problem, and only then scale what the numbers prove works. That approach now runs through every engagement as the Vicious Marketing Operating System: diagnose first, fix the cause, then scale. Eyal Dror Founder and CEO From our founder "Scaling in a regulated market isn't about finding a shortcut; it's about mastering the science of data and the art of compliance." Eyal founded Vicious Marketing on a simple conviction: you can't fix growth until you know exactly where it's breaking. He built the diagnostic approach behind the VM Operating System and leads strategy across every client engagement. What we stand for Four principles behind every engagement They decide what we will and won't do for a client. Diagnose before we prescribe We never start with a channel or a package. We start by finding out what is actually wrong, so every recommendation is aimed at the real problem. 01 Compliance is part of the work UKGC, MGA, FCA and ESMA rules are built in from the first draft, never patched on after a takedown. A win that risks your licence isn't a win. 02 Fix the cause, not the symptom More traffic won't fix a broken funnel and more spend won't fix a weak offer. We fix the part of the model that is failing, then measure it in revenue and acquisition cost. 03 Honest reporting You see the numbers a board can act on: acquisition cost, payback and pipeline, with the honest story behind them. No screenshots dressed up as results. 04 How we work The Vicious Marketing Operating System We don't start with a service. We start with your business. Every engagement runs through the same three stages, so nothing gets fixed before we know it's broken. Every engagement starts here Stage 1 Diagnose We look at your offer, funnel, channels, tracking and unit economics to find exactly where growth is breaking, and what fixing it is worth. Stage 2 Engineer We fix the specific problem the diagnosis found, using whatever it needs, SEO, paid, conversion or tracking, built to pass compliance first time. Stage 3 Scale Once the fix is proven in the numbers, we put more behind it and cut what doesn't work, so growth compounds instead of costing more. See how the VM Operating System works Our team We don't do "Brand Awareness." We do performance. A specialist team that lives in regulated acquisition, not a rotating bench of generalists. Eyal Dror Founder & CEO Sets the economics-led thesis behind the VM Operating System and leads strategy across every engagement. Jitnesh Singh Head of SEO Leads SEO and content, turning organic search into depositing players and qualified pipeline. Arpit Dixit Senior Content Writer Writes the money pages and authority content that win high-intent searches in compliance-heavy niches. Results What fixing the real problem looks like -18% Cost per first deposit UK casino operator: cost per first deposit cut by 18%. A top-15 UK casino spending £510,000 a month cut cost per first deposit from $170 to $139.40, and grew monthly first-time depositors from about 3,000 to 3,659 on the same spend. That is roughly £91,800 a month back in the budget. Read the full case study +511% Organic traffic US lender: organic traffic up 511%. CreditCube, a US personal loan provider, grew organic traffic from about 9,500 to 58,000 quarterly visits on a $12,875 SEO investment, while cutting its reliance on branded search from roughly 80% of traffic to 35%. Our Certifications Insights Blog Client Stories Events Home / Technology / Teams Voice Modern Voice with Microsoft Teams Phone Welcome to Modern Voice, where we make communication simple, easy and a little bit delightful. Our services are designed to keep you connected, whether you’re in the office, on the go, or working from home. Microsoft Teams Voice is a key component of modern communication solutions, enhancing collaboration and productivity within organisations. Let’s dive into what we offer… What is Microsoft Teams Calling? Microsoft Teams Calling is a game-changer in the realm of business communication. By extending the functionality of Microsoft Teams beyond digital collaboration, it integrates traditional phone call capabilities directly within the Teams environment. This means you can make and receive voice and video calls over the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) or an internet connection, all from within Teams. This integration signifies a significant shift in how businesses perceive and utilise communication technologies, making it easier than ever to stay connected. With Microsoft Teams Calling, your organisation can enjoy a comprehensive communication solution that redefines connectivity and collaboration. Let's Talk Why CPS? At CPS, we believe in delivering solutions that exceed expectations. Our team of experts is dedicated to providing the best communication services tailored to your needs. With our extensive experience and commitment to innovation, we ensure that you stay connected, no matter where you are. Our offerings include flexible and beneficial options like the Microsoft Teams calling plan and Microsoft Teams calling plans, which allow you to make and receive external calls directly within Microsoft Teams. Let's Talk Hosted Microsoft Teams Voice & Telephony Services CPS Modern Voice is a portfolio of services that provides the single most cost-efficient approach to enabling Microsoft Teams Phone System & Voice as a Service. By extending the Teams features to include telephony capabilities, organisations offer themselves a viable replacement for their often less capable but more expensive PBX platform. The calling plan includes domestic calling, making it easier for businesses to manage their telephony needs. Through a modular design, the CPS Modern Voice portfolio provides the single most cost-efficient approach to overcoming the PSTN connectivity challenge and enabling Teams voice as a service. For organisations already invested in Microsoft 365 and familiar with Teams collaboration and meeting capabilities, extending the Teams feature set to include telephony provides a viable replacement for the traditional PBX platform, managing both internal and external calls efficiently. CPS Modern Voice enables key calling capabilities, ensuring seamless communication and uninterrupted chats. Benefits of Microsoft Teams Phone Microsoft Teams Phones or Teams Voice offers a plethora of benefits designed to enhance your organisation’s communication and collaboration. With unified communications and collaboration tools seamlessly integrated, your team can work more efficiently and productively. The user-friendly interface provides all the features businesses need, from call queues and auto attendants to call recording and transcription. Moreover, it integrates effortlessly with existing PBX systems and Office 365 solutions, allowing IT leaders to focus on innovation and mission-critical tasks. The Microsoft Teams Phone is not only secure and reliable but also easy to manage and set up, making it an ideal choice for modern businesses. Modern Teams Phone System Modules What's included... Modern Voice: Direct Carrier-hosted Direct Routing that provides direct pairing between Microsoft Teams and the public telephone network. Modern Voice: Gateway Hosted SBC as a Service that allows organisations to use their existing SIP trunk provider for connecting Microsoft Teams to the public telephone network. Modern Voice: Connect Hosted SBC as a Service inclusive of carrier-grade SIP trunk connection and calling minutes. Additionally, Operator Connect offers a dynamic telecommunications solution that integrates with Microsoft Teams, enabling voice calling and enhancing communication capabilities with features like scalability, call management, and seamless connectivity with existing telephony infrastructures. Nearly 80 million users in over 180 countries rely on Microsoft Teams Phone to make calls richer and more collaborative. Microsoft Modern Voice Add-on Modules with Direct Routing A little extra... Modern Voice: Integration Allows the connection of a PBX or other SIP endpoint to the Teams environment for simple migration and interoperability with other platforms. Priced per node per channel, it enables PBX/ATA/SIP connection, suitable for phased migrations and cross-platform calling. Additionally, Teams can integrate with existing desk phone systems, offering a modernised communication solution while still supporting traditional desk phones for those who prefer a conventional phone setup. Modern Voice: Go-Live Support with the initial configuration and enabling activities required beyond the provisioning of the core service. This includes go-live support and assistance, assignment of numbers to users, attendant and queue configuration, and user policy configuration. Modern Voice: Support Provides a managed service for business-as-usual activities which the customer may not have the skills or resources to accommodate. This includes adds, moves, and changes, attendant and queue changes, policy updates and holiday sets, and remediation and troubleshooting. ### 1. Scope

We work with you to understand your technology needs and business goals, ensuring the solution is the right fit. Our in-house experts create a clear design showing the recommended technology and how it supports your objectives. You review it with us, and we refine the plan until it meets your requirements.

![Image 32](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/themes/rocket-saas/assets/images/flip-card.png)

![Image 33](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/conn-content-slide4.webp)

### 2. Design

This stage turns your high-level plan into a detailed delivery blueprint. We may carry out wireless and cabling surveys, assess existing infrastructure, or check security against Cyber Essentials standards. The result is a comprehensive Low-Level Design showing exactly how your solution will be built.

![Image 34](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/themes/rocket-saas/assets/images/flip-card.png)

![Image 35](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/conn-content-slide3.webp)

### 3. Implement

We pre-configure your hardware to ensure accuracy and reduce onsite delays. Our in-house nationwide Field Technicians will complete a high-quality installation, followed by onsite commissioning to finalise and ensure everything runs seamlessly.

![Image 36](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/themes/rocket-saas/assets/images/flip-card.png)

![Image 37](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/verify-1024x683.jpg)

### 4. Verify

We verify your new solution delivers the performance and security you expect through comprehensive testing. If needed, we fine-tune the setup and then fully document everything as an as-built solution.

![Image 38](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/themes/rocket-saas/assets/images/flip-card.png)

![Image 39](https://www.ukconnect.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/conn-content-slide1.webp)

### 5. Monitor

Our Farnbourough-based Network Operations Centre runs 24/7, with analysts continuously monitoring and optimising performance across all your sites. We proactively identify and resolve most issues before they reach you, and if on-site support is needed, we can arrange an engineer for the next business day.

## FAQs

### Can we choose the level of expertise we need?

Yes. You can deploy highly skilled network specialists for design and complex work, or practical on-site engineers for installations and changes, or a mix of both. This allows you to match skills to the task, rather than paying for over-qualified resource where it isn’t needed.

### How quickly can you get engineers to site?

Response times depend on location, scope and urgency, but our nationwide coverage allows us to mobilise quickly across the UK. Urgent break-fix issues, planned installations and scheduled rollouts are all supported through clearly defined service levels.

### Is this more cost-effective than hiring in-house engineers?

For many organisations, yes. Using UK Connect reduces the need for permanent recruitment, training, travel, idle time and specialist overheads. You get access to the skills you need, when you need them, without carrying long-term employment costs.

### Do you provide nationwide coverage?

Yes. We deliver consistent engineering standards across the UK, allowing you to support regional or national estates without managing multiple local suppliers

### How do you ensure consistent quality across different sites?

All work is clearly scoped, engineers are matched to the task, and delivery follows consistent standards nationwide. Full documentation, including photos and sign-off where required, provides visibility and assurance across every visit.

### Can you support live and operational environments?

Absolutely. We regularly work in live sites where safety, uptime and compliance are critical, including construction sites, warehouses, manufacturing environments and public-facing venues.

### Do you work alongside our internal teams or other contractors?

Yes. We frequently collaborate with in-house IT teams, facilities teams, principal contractors and third parties. Our role flexes to fit your operating model, providing support where it adds the most value.

### Is this suitable for short-term projects as well as long-term programmes?

Yes. We support ad-hoc site visits, defined projects and ongoing programmes. You can scale usage up or down as requirements change.

### How is pricing structured?

Pricing is transparent and clearly scoped based on the work required, location and skill level needed. There are no hidden costs, and you only pay for the services you use.

### How do we get started?

It begins with a short conversation to understand your sites, challenges and priorities. From there, we’ll recommend the right mix of Field Services and Network & Professional Services to support your organisation.

More ways to sell through the marketplace with professional services | Microsoft Community Hub Open Side Menu Skip to content Tech Community Community Hubs Products Topics Blogs Events Skills Hub Community Register Sign In Microsoft Community Hub Communities Topics Microsoft Partner Community Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Marketplace blog Blog Post Marketplace blog 3 MIN READ More ways to sell through the marketplace with professional services justinroyal Microsoft Sep 11, 2024 Cloud marketplaces continue to increase in popularity as the preferred way for organizations to find, try, and buy software—especially as cloud and AI needs continue to become more complex. The Microsoft commercial marketplace is central to how we sell alongside you, our partners, to help you reach more customers, simplify sales, and unlock growth. To support you with more ways to service your customers, Microsoft now empowers partners in Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States to sell professional services through private offers in the marketplace. For software development companies, you often need to account for a variety of services to support your product sales. Whether that’s assisting with implementation, training your customers, or providing support over the long-term, the value of your teams’ time and resources can be accounted for directly within your marketplace sales with professional services for private offers. And, for other partners like systems integrators, managed service providers, etc., they can provide professional services (through a private offer) to support their customers who prefer the simplicity of purchasing through the marketplace. Watch this demo video to learn more about unlocking growth by selling professional services. The value for you and your customers As customers shift to marketplaces to centralize their cloud portfolio, they can further simplify purchasing by streamlining software and services purchases through one platform. Customers can get your solutions while buying directly from Microsoft, and have purchases consolidated directly on their Azure invoice. As a partner, you can skip the hassle of vendor onboarding while dramatically simplifying your sales—while reaching a global market. Plus, by bundling your software and service, you decrease time-to-value for your customer. “Now that professional services are offered within the Microsoft commercial marketplace, it gives us another path to service our customers with simplified selling. And we can bundle our service and product together, helping our customers cut through procurement red tape.” - TeamViewer How it works For partners in eligible geographies, you can now: sell your professional services as a standalone private offer or attach your professional services to a private offer alongside your software. Examples of professional services include: assessments, briefings, customer support, implementation, migration, proof of concepts, and workshops. These professional services are sold as private offers. You can inform your customer that the private offer is ready directly from Partner Center when you build the offer. The customer th e n receives an email that directs them to the Azure portal. Assuming they have proper permissions, the customer will accept and purchase the professional services private offer. With the private offer, you can also negotiate your terms and use flat-rate billing plans including upfront, monthly, or annual payments for up to three years Any company who is part of the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program can sell professional services. Details are provided in our documentation, but at a high-level: Be a member of the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program (it’s free to join) Sign the marketplace publisher agreement Publish your offer Sell professional services private offers Get started with marketplace The Microsoft commercial marketplace is dedicated to helping you reach more customers, simplify sales, and unlock growth. If you’re building an application and looking to maximize marketplace success, consider joining ISV Success. Partners who join get access to free benefits, designed to help you build across the Microsoft Cloud, publish faster, and grow your partnership opportunity. Get details on how to join in the ISV Hub . To get started selling professional services, check out the technical documentation . This category of services encompasses many sectors, including legal, accounting, consulting, research and development, architecture and engineering, and advertising. U.S. exports in professional and business services reached $189 billion in 2019. Imports totaled $76 billion. Most U.S. trade in professional and business services is with Europe, which received 55 percent of U.S. exports in this industry in 2019.  About half of U.S. professional and business services imports came from Europe. The Asia-Pacific region attracted close to one-fourth of U.S. exports and accounted for 31 percent of U.S. imports. Employment and Wages In 2019, over 9.3 million people worked in the professional and business services industry in the United States. Roughly 23 percent of those jobs were in the computer systems design and related services sector, which leads the industry in employment. Architecture and engineering and consulting services each employed 16 percent of individuals in this industry. These jobs may be either full-time or part-time. The average annual wage across all professional and business services is relatively high at $85,720. The mean annual wage for each sector within this industry, as defined by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, exceeded the average for all occupations of $53,490 in 2019. The bottom line is that U.S. jobs in professional services generally offer a very competitive wage compared with other sectors of the economy. Access the full data for all of these charts . × Global Business Navigator Chatbot Beta Welcome to the Global Business Navigator, an artificial intelligence (AI) Chatbot from the International Trade Administration (ITA). This tool, currently in beta version testing, is designed to provide general information on the exporting process and the resources available to assist new and experienced U.S. exporters. The Chatbot, developed using Microsoft’s Azure AI services, is trained on ITA’s export-related content and aims to quickly get users the information they need. The Chatbot is intended to make the benefits of exporting more accessible by understanding non-expert language, idiomatic expressions, and foreign languages. Limitations As a beta product, the Chatbot is currently being tested and its responses may occasionally produce inaccurate or incomplete information. The Chatbot is trained to decline out of scope or inappropriate requests. The Chatbot’s knowledge is limited to the public information on the Export Solutions web pages of Trade.gov, which covers a wide range of topics on exporting. While it cannot provide responses specific to a company’s product or a specific foreign market, its reference pages will guide you to other relevant government resources and market research. Always double-check the Chatbot’s responses using the provided references or by visiting the Export Solutions web pages on Trade.gov. Do not use its responses as legal or professional advice. Inaccurate advice from the Chatbot would not be a defense to violating any export rules or regulations. Privacy The Chatbot does not collect information about users and does not use the contents of users’ chat history to learn new information. All feedback is anonymous. Please do not enter personally identifiable information (PII), sensitive, or proprietary information into the Chatbot. Your conversations will not be connected to other interactions or accounts with ITA. Conversations with the Chatbot may be reviewed to help ITA improve the tool and address harmful, illegal, or otherwise inappropriate questions. Translation The Chatbot supports a wide range of languages. Because the Chatbot is trained in English and responses are translated, you should verify the translation. For example, the Chatbot may have difficulty with acronyms, abbreviations, and nuances in a language other than English. ## Global Business Navigator Chatbot Beta

Welcome to the Global Business Navigator, an artificial intelligence (AI) Chatbot from the International Trade Administration (ITA). This tool, currently in beta version testing, is designed to provide general information on the exporting process and the resources available to assist new and experienced U.S. exporters. The Chatbot, developed using Microsoft’s Azure AI services, is trained on ITA’s export-related content and aims to quickly get users the information they need. The Chatbot is intended to make the benefits of exporting more accessible by understanding non-expert language, idiomatic expressions, and foreign languages.

### Limitations

As a beta product, the Chatbot is currently being tested and its responses may occasionally produce inaccurate or incomplete information. The Chatbot is trained to decline out of scope or inappropriate requests. The Chatbot’s knowledge is limited to the public information on the [Export Solutions](https://www.trade.gov/export-solutions) web pages of Trade.gov, which covers a wide range of topics on exporting. While it cannot provide responses specific to a company’s product or a specific foreign market, its reference pages will guide you to other relevant government resources and market research. Always double-check the Chatbot’s responses using the provided references or by visiting the [Export Solutions](https://www.trade.gov/export-solutions) web pages on Trade.gov. Do not use its responses as legal or professional advice. Inaccurate advice from the Chatbot would not be a defense to violating any export rules or regulations.

### Privacy

The Chatbot does not collect information about users and does not use the contents of users’ chat history to learn new information. All feedback is anonymous. Please do not enter personally identifiable information (PII), sensitive, or proprietary information into the Chatbot. Your conversations will not be connected to other interactions or accounts with ITA. Conversations with the Chatbot may be reviewed to help ITA improve the tool and address harmful, illegal, or otherwise inappropriate questions.

### Translation

The Chatbot supports a wide range of languages. Because the Chatbot is trained in English and responses are translated, you should verify the translation. For example, the Chatbot may have difficulty with acronyms, abbreviations, and nuances in a language other than English.

# About Us

## Who we are

### ♦ Our Mission

Create prosperity by strengthening the international competitiveness of U.S. industry, promoting trade and investment, and ensuring fair trade and compliance with trade laws and agreements.

### ♦ Our Focus

*   Promote U.S. exports
*   Attract inbound investment
*   Provide actionable data and information
*   Defend against unfair trade

### ♦ Our People

Our trade experts and professional staff - approximately 2,200 employees - are positioned in more than 100 U.S. cities and 80 international markets.

## Global Business Navigator Chatbot Beta

Welcome to the Global Business Navigator, an artificial intelligence (AI) Chatbot from the International Trade Administration (ITA). This tool, currently in beta version testing, is designed to provide general information on the exporting process and the resources available to assist new and experienced U.S. exporters. The Chatbot, developed using Microsoft’s Azure AI services, is trained on ITA’s export-related content and aims to quickly get users the information they need. The Chatbot is intended to make the benefits of exporting more accessible by understanding non-expert language, idiomatic expressions, and foreign languages.

### Limitations

As a beta product, the Chatbot is currently being tested and its responses may occasionally produce inaccurate or incomplete information. The Chatbot is trained to decline out of scope or inappropriate requests. The Chatbot’s knowledge is limited to the public information on the [Export Solutions](https://www.trade.gov/export-solutions) web pages of Trade.gov, which covers a wide range of topics on exporting. While it cannot provide responses specific to a company’s product or a specific foreign market, its reference pages will guide you to other relevant government resources and market research. Always double-check the Chatbot’s responses using the provided references or by visiting the [Export Solutions](https://www.trade.gov/export-solutions) web pages on Trade.gov. Do not use its responses as legal or professional advice. Inaccurate advice from the Chatbot would not be a defense to violating any export rules or regulations.

### Privacy

The Chatbot does not collect information about users and does not use the contents of users’ chat history to learn new information. All feedback is anonymous. Please do not enter personally identifiable information (PII), sensitive, or proprietary information into the Chatbot. Your conversations will not be connected to other interactions or accounts with ITA. Conversations with the Chatbot may be reviewed to help ITA improve the tool and address harmful, illegal, or otherwise inappropriate questions.

### Translation

The Chatbot supports a wide range of languages. Because the Chatbot is trained in English and responses are translated, you should verify the translation. For example, the Chatbot may have difficulty with acronyms, abbreviations, and nuances in a language other than English.
